chunks: And al-‘Alā’ narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two of them, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked him about collateral and a guarantor in a deferred sale. He said: There is no harm in it.

key_terms.الرَّهْنِ: pledged collateral given as security in a transaction
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to require collateral or a guarantor in a deferred payment sale in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling permitting the use of pledged collateral and a guarantor in a deferred payment sale. It indicates the permissibility of such financial safeguards within transactional law.
